meta.beschreibung: Partner dashboard of the myNextDays partner program: links, customers, commissions, payouts.

pending_review.text: We review each application personally and will contact you by email. Until approval, links and codes are not yet active - you can already complete your profile and payout data.

rejected.text: We could not accept your application at this time. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.

suspended.text: Open commissions will not be paid out as long as the suspension is in effect. If you have any questions, please contact us.

uebersicht.textBewerber: Once your application is approved, you will see your links, customers and commissions here. In the meantime, enter your tax and payout data - then the first payout can run without further queries.

kachel.strukturHinweis: own + team customers — this number determines your rank
kachel.superHinweis: {satz} on the subscription revenue of your structure, without time limit
kachel.turboHinweis: From Elite-Partner onwards: 0.5% per booking via myBestDays for your customers and team customers

links.hinweis: Your link leads to mynextdays.com and counts the click. The code is visible in the form during registration - without a cookie. A business is assigned to exactly one partner.
links.kopierenFehlgeschlagen: Copy not possible - please highlight and copy.
links.label: Description (optional)

kennzeichnung.text: Every recommendation with your link or code is advertising and must be identifiable as such — at the beginning of the post, in the language of the post. A mere "#ad" is not enough. Violations can lead to suspension.
kennzeichnung.andere: Other countries: The commercial intent must be clearly identifiable (EU Directive on unfair commercial practices). Please check the requirements of your country; we will add documented wordings gradually.

material.leer: Material is being prepared — it will appear here once approved.

kunden.hinweis: Your referred businesses — pseudonymized. You see country, status, and amounts, never name or email. Paying means: first subscription invoice paid and subscription is active.
kunden.leer: No business has registered via your link yet.

provisionen.hinweis: Each line is a paid subscription invoice, a booking via myBestDays, or a promotion bonus. The basis is the net subscription revenue or the booking value; the rate is your rank at the time of payment. Open lines become payable after 30 days.

auszahlungen.hinweis: Monthly, per currency, from the minimum amount. Each payout is accompanied by a credit note (self-billing) — this is your receipt.
auszahlungen.kein_weg: No payout method has been set up yet. Please add it under Profile — otherwise, payouts cannot be made.
auszahlungen.gutschriftFehler: Credit note could not be loaded.

profil.name: Name
profil.kanal: Your social media accounts and channels
profil.gespeichertViesOffen: Saved. The VAT ID could not yet be confirmed — we will check it again before payout.
profil.ustIdHinweis: Will be checked against the EU VIES system. Without a confirmed number, no payout to companies. The credit note will include the reverse-charge note.
profil.privatHinweis: As a private person, you will receive the credit note without VAT. You are responsible for taxing the commission yourself.

anmelden.resetGesendet: If an account exists, we have sent an email.
anmelden.stoerung: The login service is currently unavailable. This is not due to your credentials — please try again later.
anmelden.keinPartnerKonto: No partner account exists with these credentials.
anmelden.passwortNeuIntro: Enter the code from the email and choose a new password. You will be signed in afterwards.
anmelden.resetCodeHinweis: The six-digit number from the “Reset password” email.

bewerben.text: Two minutes. We review each application personally and will contact you by email.
bewerben.name: Your Name
bewerben.ustIdHinweis: Required for companies; checked against VIES.
bewerben.kanalHinweis: Required: at least one social media account (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, etc.) with address, handle, and reach. Website, blog, or newsletter are welcome additions. We will review the accounts before approval.
bewerben.pitch: How do you reach vacation rental owners or hotels? (optional)
bewerben.zustimmung: I accept the partner terms and conditions, in particular the obligation to label recommendations as advertising.
bewerben.captchaHinweis: This page is protected by reCAPTCHA; Google's Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.
bewerben.stoerung: The service is currently unavailable - please try again later.
bewerben.emailVergeben: There is already an application for this email address. Please log in.
bewerben.captchaFehler: The security check failed. Please reload the page and try again.
bewerben.sponsorHinweis: Are you here via a partner's team link? Their code will be here. They receive a team commission on your customers' subscription revenue — your own commission remains unchanged.

nachrichten.hinweis: Your direct line to the partner team — questions about commission, payout, materials, or a customer. Answers appear live here.
nachrichten.neu: New message to the partner team
nachrichten.stoerung: The service is currently unavailable — please try again later.

kanaele.socialPflicht: At least one social media account is required — a website alone is not sufficient.
kanaele.handleUngueltig: The username may only contain letters, numbers, periods, underscores, and hyphens — no @ and no spaces.

team.hinweis: Partners who applied with your code form your team. You receive the difference between your rate (currently {satz}) and the team partner's rate — both at the time of payment — on the net subscription revenue of their customers. Team customers count 1:1 for your rank.
team.meinSponsor: You are a team partner of {name}.

link.text: Anyone who applies via this link will have your code visibly included in their application — without a cookie.
link.keinLink: No active code — create one under Links & Material.

regeln.rang: Team commission = your rate minus the highest rate already paid on the same revenue below you, at the time of payment. Same or higher rank below you = 0.
regeln.ebene: Across all levels: Your team partners build their own teams, every level counts towards rank and team commission.
regeln.keinGeld: No money for recruitment — only from paid subscription revenue.
regeln.dauer: 12 months per team customer, 30-day refund window. From Elite onwards, an additional 2.5% super commission without time limit — several Elite in one chain share it in equal parts.

mitglieder.leer: No team partners yet. Share your team link.

team.nochNichtErlaubt: You lead a team from the rank of Climber (5 paying customers in your structure). Until then, there is no team link.

bedingungen.neueVersion: The partner terms and conditions have been updated (your consent: version {alt}, current: {neu}). Please read and agree again.
bedingungen.nochNicht: Please agree to the partner terms and conditions (version {neu}).

beitraege.hinweis: Create a unique link for each reel, video, or post. This way, you can see which post generates clicks, registrations, and paying customers.
beitraege.kontoHinweis: Connect your account, and views and interactions from the platform will also appear here.
beitraege.keinCode: You need an active referral code first.

feld.urlHinweis: Can be added after publishing. With an address, we assign views and interactions to the post.

beitraege.angelegt: Post created — the link is ready.
beitraege.doppelt: This post already exists for the code.
beitraege.fehler: That didn't work. Please try again.
beitraege.leer: No posts yet. Create the first link above.
beitraege.loeschenGesperrt: The post already has registrations and will be retained.
beitraege.kopierenFehlgeschlagen: Copy not possible — please select manually.
beitraege.qrHinweis: For stories, videos, and print — leads to the same link.

freigabe.erklaerung: Upload your finished video, image, or PDF before publishing it. Once approved, your personal link will appear here — then you can add it to your post. Only use our promotional material, no self-made screenshots, and no promises of success or guarantees.
freigabe.eingereicht: Video submitted. We will contact you once it has been reviewed.
freigabe.inPruefungHinweis: We have received your video. Your link will appear here once it has been approved.
freigabe.eingereichtAm: Submitted on {zeit} — your link will appear here once it has been approved.
freigabe.zuGross: The video is larger than {mb} MB.

grundKategorie.material: Material: only official promotional material, no self-made screenshots
grundKategorie.promise: Promises: no guarantees or promises of success
grundKategorie.disclosure: Labeling: the post must be marked as advertisement
grundKategorie.brand: Brand: logo or name used incorrectly

kanalVerbindung.hinweis: Connect your social media accounts so followers and views come directly from the platform. This is voluntary and can be revoked at any time; we only read, we do not write.
kanalVerbindung.nichtKonfiguriert: This connection is not yet activated.
kanalVerbindung.fehler: That didn't work. Please try again.
kanalVerbindung.getrennt: Connection disconnected. Previous measurements remain as history.
kanalVerbindung.getrennteKonten: {n, plural, =1 {1 disconnected account} other {# disconnected accounts}}
kanalVerbindung.datenschutz: When disconnecting, we immediately delete the access data. Measured values remain stored as history. Details in the privacy policy.

rueckkehr.verbunden: Account connected - the first measurement is running.
rueckkehr.abgelehnt: Connection aborted - you did not grant access.

verbundkonto.hinweis: Your commission will be transferred to a connected account. Our payment service provider requires an identity verification for this purpose — as long as it is open, no payout can be made.
verbundkonto.bereit: Your connected account is activated. Payouts will automatically go there.
verbundkonto.idNummerHinweis: Your national personal ID, e.g. CPR (DK), personnummer (SE/FI), NIF (ES), PESEL (PL), codice fiscale (IT).
verbundkonto.webseiteHinweis: The address where you advertise — required for verification.
verbundkonto.firmaHinweis: As an authorized representative, your above-mentioned information will be used.
verbundkonto.waehrungHinweis: The currency of the bank account, not that of your country.
verbundkonto.identitaetHinweis: Finally, our payment service provider verifies your identity. This takes place on their secure page, as a photo will be taken; afterwards, you will return here.
